# Vendored original SCMs

These four files are byte-for-byte copies of the example structural causal model JSON files from:

- Repository: `https://github.com/KeHang-Zhu/lm-automated-social-science`
- Immutable commit: `c694c28190464a36349638e7d50f9291d081760d`
- Original path: `src/Example/`
- Retrieved: 2026-10-14
- Upstream project: *Automated Social Science: Language Models as Scientist and Subjects*

They are intentionally kept in their original double-encoded JSON representation. Do not format or normalize them.
